speech._clientsNote: Language layer (B-18/X-05, docs/agent/LANGUAGE_LAYER.md). REST clients by id; every one ships DISABLED with ${PLACEHOLDER} endpoints and keys that resolve from local.properties SPEECH_* entries (never committed). To turn one on: put its SPEECH_* values in local.properties, set enabled=true, then list its id under providers.speech.asr.online.<lang> / tts.<role> (models.json) or mt.<direction> (below). A client that is disabled, missing a key or not https is never built, so routing falls through to the on-device engines.

gemini_tts._note: 29 Oct 2026 (owner: 'kore'): ENGLISH replies in Google's Gemini TTS voice Kore with the owner's Ghanaian-English style prompt (his Kaggle comparison of 6 voices x 6 lines). Unary REST /v1beta/interactions, one sentence a request (RoutingTts fetches the next while one plays). Keys, tried in order, a spent one skipped until it resets: SPEECH_GEMINI_TTS_KEY (a paid key, when there is one) then the app's existing GEMINI_API_KEY, _3, _2 (the build passes them as SPEECH_GEMINI_KEY_1..3; free tier = 10 voice requests a key a day; _2 last because it is the one used for tests). Offline the phone's own Kafui voice speaks with no wait. Privacy: a free-tier key lets Google's reviewers read the text (Gemini API terms) — use a paid-tier key for messages and amounts.

fields.style: Speak in a natural, contemporary Ghanaian English accent. Use natural Ghanaian English rhythm, intonation, stress, and phrasing without exaggerating the accent or sounding stereotypical. Sound warm, clear, respectful, and conversational. Prioritize intelligibility for blind and low-vision users. Speak at a moderate pace with clear articulation and natural pauses between sentences. Pronounce Ghanaian names, place names, phone numbers, Ghana cedis, and pesewas carefully. Maintain consistent pronunciation. Do not paraphrase, omit, or add words. Read the supplied text exactly as written.

space_tts_eng._note: 19 Oct 2026 (owner: 'Is it possible you add his voice?'): ENGLISH replies in Kafui Dey's voice — the language Space's English is ONLY the F5 Kafui voice (an error, never another voice, when its ZeroGPU fails). Used through providers.speech.tts.ghEnglish: RoutingTts fetches sentence by sentence, the first within speech.ghEnglish.firstWaitMs (6 s), and the English chain (own on-device voice, the phone's engine) speaks when it is off, resting, slow or failing. speech.ghEnglish.enabled=false turns it off at once.

openai_asr._note: Any OpenAI-compatible /audio/transcriptions server, e.g. a hosted Ghanaian-English Whisper tune. Ghanaian English ONLY (Whisper has no Twi token) — list it under asr.online.gh_en, never twi or auto. Reuses the existing local.properties slots ASR_ONLINE_URL (…/v1), ASR_ONLINE_KEY, ASR_ONLINE_MODEL.

mt._note: Translator ids per direction, tried in order (a client without its key isn't built and is skipped). enToTwi localizes English replies for a Twi speaker (ReplyLocalizer: never text with numbers/money, names must survive, else the original is spoken). twiToEn puts a Twi request into English for the cloud planner, which gets BOTH (VoiceEngine.goalInEnglish → RoutingBrain.cloudGoalFor).
mt._waitsNote: 20 Oct 2026 (reliability audit): every Twi translation wait capped so a reply is never 38-53 s of silence; rehearsed lines come from MtDiskCache at once.

language._englishOnlyNote: Nexus, 31 Oct 2026 (owner): English only — every turn is English whatever was stored before (settings.languageMode reads ENGLISH while this is true); false brings the old modes back.
language._note: B-05 LanguageSession: replies follow the language of the user's last turn while the conversation is live (conversationTtlSec); the persisted habitual language (the low-signal fallback after a pause) changes only after habitualSwitchTurns turns in a row in the other language.
